newsitem.title: USA: Kimberly-Clark buys Spanish diaper unit.
newsitem.headline: Kimberly-Clark buys Spanish diaper unit.

text.p: Kimberly-Clark Corp said on Monday it acquired the Monbebe diaper business in Spain and Portugal from the Lyhsa/Autex Group, further expanding its European holdings.
Terms of the purchase were not disclosed.

The acquisition, which includes a manufacturing plant in Calatayud, Spain, boosts Kimberly-Clark to 21 percent of the Spanish market and 13 percent of the Portuguese market, the company said. The combined diaper markets in the two countries totals $480 million, and is growing at 2 percent annually.

In 1996 Kimberly-Clark bought the Peaudouce diaper brand in France and the Zisoft-Bobi diaper company in the Czech Republic. That year, European sales accounted for almost $3 billion of Kimberly-Clark's $13 billion in revenue, the company said.
